items.title: How much does the review window length actually matter?
items.description: RFC-014 used a 5-day review window, and Marco's blocking objection surfaced on day 4 — close to the edge. Drag the window length to see roughly how it trades off against the chance a real blocking objection gets caught before implementation starts, versus discovered later in production. Short windows are fast but risk shipping the gap; long windows catch more but slow the team down.
items.compute: const k = 0.3; const catchProbability = Math.round((1 - Math.exp(-k * params.reviewWindowDays)) * 90); return { catchProbability };

outputs.label: Chance a real blocking objection is caught before implementation
